description: This file defines an interface IErrorGrain for unit testing error handling in Orleans grains, including methods for logging, setting errors, retrieving error states, and simulating delays and errors.

classes.name: IErrorGrain
classes.description: Interface for error simulation and logging in Orleans grains, extending ISimpleGrain.

methods.name: SetAError
methods.description: Sets an error state A with an integer value.

methods.name: SetBError
methods.description: Sets an error state B with an integer value.

methods.name: GetAxBError
methods.description: Retrieves the combined error state A x B.

methods.name: GetAxBError
methods.description: Retrieves the combined error state A x B with parameters a and b.

methods.name: LongMethod
methods.description: Simulates a long-running operation with a wait time.

methods.name: LongMethodWithError
methods.description: Simulates a long operation that may produce an error.

methods.name: DelayMethod
methods.description: Delays execution for a specified number of milliseconds.

methods.name: UnobservedErrorImmediate
methods.description: Returns an error value immediately, possibly unobserved.

methods.name: UnobservedErrorDelayed
methods.description: Returns an error value after a delay, possibly unobserved.

methods.name: UnobservedErrorContinuation2
methods.description: Returns an error value with continuation, possibly unobserved.

methods.name: UnobservedErrorContinuation3
methods.description: Returns an error value with continuation, possibly unobserved.

methods.name: UnobservedIgnoredError
methods.description: Returns an error that is ignored.

methods.name: AddChildren
methods.description: Adds child grains to the current grain.

methods.name: ExecuteDelayed
methods.description: Executes an operation after a delay, returning success or failure.
